objective: Require important autonomous-worker decisions to use one revision-bound Guidance-Coordinator-workflow-ui batch.

owners.coordinator: batch identity, revision, and durable persistence
owners.workflow-ui: typed user response for every point

invariants: An important or ambiguous decision has a Guidance trigger
All independent AR points share one Coordinator batch and one UI session
Every response and persistence reference matches the current task revision
A conversational answer, stale response, partial batch, or cross-AR event fails closed
The worker resumes only from the complete Coordinator persistence event
